name: The Nine Landings (Cửu Độ Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Round the Bend, Then the Anchor (Hồi Khúc Trầm Mao)
bonuses.rule: each blow you slip with the Nine Bends also takes one toll from a Tolled foe, as if it had cast; when you arrive at nine Bends, the anchor drops with you: a Water hit that ignores half the foe's ward.

story: The founder's seal and anchor, and his Dao partner's coat. Giang Cửu Khúc holds all three. The Drowned Anchor of the catalogue stays aboard his boat.
